en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.146 - Hariz narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

'If a man has a condition where urine or blood drips from him, then at the time of prayer, he should use a pouch filled with cotton, attach it, and place his private part inside it.
Then he should pray, combining the Dhuhr and Asr prayers by delaying Dhuhr and advancing Asr with one call to prayer (adhan) and two calls to commence (iqamah). Similarly, he should delay Maghrib and advance Isha with one adhan and two iqamah. He should do the same for Fajr.'.
